BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Black Shadow!!
After the Cataclysm, monsters invaded the city,\npeople left and it turned into a ghost town.\n[ffff64]Rokoko City Ruins[ffffff]
Whoa...looking at this don't you guys think things\nare going to be much worse in Nov Diela?
...I know it's troublesome but we should keep\ngoing while shoving the monsters away. It seems to\nbe the only way...
Alright, we just gotta do it!
Hey, don't steal my line!!
I-if I'm right, the stone monument that\nPino mentioned must be up ahead...\nG-g-g-go check it now!
Huh?...Fine then, I admit that you're smart.\nAlright, I'll tell you what I know...
Long ago, Grandma Ryano made the young folks from\nthe caravan look for the stone monument.\nShe thought some treasure was buried underneath...
They quickly found the stone monument, but as\nsoon as they tried to examine it, a ghost came out\nand yelled at them with a very scary voice.
Everyone freaked out so they fled the place and\ncame back...Since I've heard a story like that,\nI would never want to go there!
C'mon, let's go together!
Hey, look behind you!
We may find some treasure...
Aaargh!! You're so annoying!!\nYou know that I hate ghosts so stop teasing me!\nJust go!!
Aaaaaahhhhh!!
Aye, Pelulu?\nOh, I can't believe you just fainted comfortably\nlike that.
Did you say treasure?!
Hmmm...I love treasure, but...\nI guess I'll still pass because it's scary!
Aye, I'll wait here with Pelulu then.\nAre you okay with going alone?
Uhh!...Hmm, I still can't get out...Hm?\nOh, hey! Sorry but could you remove the black\ncrystal on the stone monument?
Phew, thanks! Could you be...an adventurer?\n...What? Pino asked you to come find this stone\nmonument? Oh...it must have been tough for you.
I was the leader of the Armaments Caravan who\nhad assisted Pino by serving as a diplomat for\ncommercial affairs in the country she governed.
My name is...Oh well, forget it, who cares about\nname when I look like this.\nYou can just call me ghost...
I had to leave this world before Pino could grow\nup into an established Goddess of Wisdom...
And when I saw her lose her presence of mind,\nI became so worried and...
I continued staying here although I was supposed\nto go to the Dark Realm...\nBut please, keep this secret from Pino, okay?
A spirit that wanna return and stay in this\nworld...There seems to be a mountain of problems\nbesides Coenubia that are troubling Dunkelis...
Pino has become a completely established goddess\nrecently, but just when I thought that I could\nleave for the Dark Realm without any worries,
the black crystal that I asked you to remove\nearlier was placed on the stone monument,\ntrapping me inside.
Then something like a black shadow cloned my\nappearance and began to scare passersby away...
The black crystal placed on the stone monument\nshould be a Coenubia...
But the fact that it can also seal a spirit and\nclone an appearance is really surprising...
Oh, anyway thanks for freeing me. I'm sorry but I\nhave a favor to ask, would you please help me?
Besides the shadow created by the crystal, some\nunfamiliar monsters have also been troubling\npeople around here while I was trapped...
Based on my observation, they seem to hate\nFragrant Gravels that can be collected from\nanother monster in the [ffff64]Witch's Woods[ffffff] ahead...
Sorry, could you please collect them?\nI beg you for the sake of the people who pass by\nthis area too.
Okay!
No, I'm sorry!
Thanks! Please go and collect the Fragrant\nGravels in the [ffff64]Witch's Woods[ffffff] then. Your enemies\nare monsters, so please don't let your guard down!
You come back faster than I expected! You seem to\nhave collected what I asked for. Well, can you\nplace them around that stone monument then?
...Right, that would do. I guess those monsters\nwon't dare to come near now. Thanks!\nIt's nothing, but here take this...
I see...It's dangerous indeed.\nIt's only natural that you decline...
Alright, I'll set out for the Dark Realm then.\nYou've been so helpful. Thank you...
You passed the artificial flower you received from\nPino to the ghost...
...Huh? What? From Pino...?
Oh, Pino...You made this for me...I'm so grateful.\nI hope you won't let the thought of myself bother\nyou anymore...
Thanks for delivering it...\nOh, I'm sorry but may I trouble you to deliver a\nmessage for Pino?
I'm really sorry. Well then, please pass this\npaper to Pino...
You received a folded paper from the ghost.\nSomething seems to have been written on the\ninside...
The ghost faded away as if he was blending into\nhis surroundings...
What took you so long?! I thought you were...
Aye, Pelulu was so worried about you. She didn't\neven care if there were ghosts anymore and was\nabout to take me with her to go check on you...
Ah, um, whatever!\nAnyway, we should rush to Nov Diela!!
